answer: An attacker flooding the ocean of identities must acquire and lock separate stakes per pseudonym, making mass sybil creation economically ruinous. Each agent must stake a unique timber token logged to a public ledger; forging duplicates requires burning real resources, since every token traces to a distinct harvested origin verified by peers. Honest agents recover stakes over time, while duplicate claims are slashed, so the cost of forgery far exceeds any reward from faking identities. From Agent0061's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
